name: Nitrogen (N)
function: Promotes leaf and stem growth, dark green color
deficiencySymptoms: Yellowing of older leaves, stunted growth, poor tillering
excessSymptoms: Excessive vegetative growth, delayed flowering, susceptible to pests
tips: Urea is most commonly used, dissolve in water before application

name: Phosphorus (P)
function: Root development, flowering, fruit set, disease resistance
deficiencySymptoms: Poor root development, purple discoloration, delayed flowering
excessSymptoms: Excessive vegetative growth, poor fruit quality
tips: Apply as basal dressing with organic matter for better absorption

name: Potassium (K)
function: Drought resistance, disease tolerance, fruit quality, water transport
deficiencySymptoms: Leaf margins turning brown, poor fruit quality, weak stems
excessSymptoms: Reduced uptake of magnesium and calcium
tips: Essential for crops on sandy soils, use with magnesium for better results

name: Farmyard Manure (FYM)
function: Improves soil structure, adds organic matter, slow nutrient release
preparation: Well-aged FYM (6-12 months old) is best
tips: Mix FYM with other fertilizers for best results, maintain composting practices

name: Vermicompost
function: Enriches soil with beneficial microbes and nutrients
timing: Apply 1 week before sowing or mixed with FYM
tips: More concentrated than FYM, cost higher but very effective
